cache_choice_rule: Only select process-local reuse if measured replay cost and expected repeated workload justify it; hash all complete trust inputs, retain the independent full verifier. No persistent checkpoint is trusted from its self digest.
correctness_acceptance: Each operation repeats the same explicitly declared inputs and produces an identical output digest for its case; session teardown clears memory; every store replay verifies actual local signatures and chain.
evidence_acceptance: PASS means complete bounded measurement reporting, including failed or setup-blocked cases. It does not mean performance ceilings passed. Variance and identical digests are reported only for actual successful samples; no duration, digest or outcome is fabricated for incomplete samples.
performance_acceptance: Report every duration, variance, environment, count and digest. Resource ceilings are experiment limits, not a Product SLA. Do not infer cache value from suite duration.

revision_basis.reason: Observed setup overrun and session sample timeout require bounded failure reporting. All three transaction counts remain declared; failing samples retain null digest and unsupported cases remain explicit. The larger total envelope allows all bounded cases to be attempted serially.

scopes.independent_source_capture: C04 candidate explicit D75 selection, complete original bytes and controls
scopes.other_operations: Frozen v2 baseline code in separate temporary stores; no old receipts changed
scopes.schema_validation: One exact Work contract/body, not a claim about all schemas
scopes.session_inputs: Fixed clock/UUID injection for repeatable benchmark inputs; no real Agent-work or usability claim
